extraction_hints: On the OR Record (and H&P) 'Attending Surgeon:' tick-box line, the printed options on this mission are NB / KC / SG / ZS. Report whichever is ticked/circled exactly as printed -- do not expect any other initials.
On the OR Record 'Assistant:' tick-box line, the printed options on this mission are PJ / AC / CC / KK. Report whichever is ticked exactly as printed -- do not expect any other initials.

On the OR Record 'Anesthesiologist/CRNA:' tick-box line, the printed options on this mission are MJ / PK, plus a write-in 'Other:' line. Report whichever is ticked exactly as printed, or transcribe the write-in if 'Other' is used -- do not expect any other initials.

Some packets on this mission (e.g. GH17-901) carry their own embedded 'ISHI Post-Op Visit' page within the packet itself; others do not. If a packet has no embedded Post-Op Visit page, leave those fields blank/flagged as usual -- do NOT attempt to pull data from the separate compiled 'ISHI post op visits' batch files, which are out of scope for this extraction run (see _readme).
_calibration: Calibrated from sample packets before the full run (calibration notes withheld from the public release).
